name: 31014-specbench-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), FlashAttention 3.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128, bounded at 1280 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 320 requests. Matched by `max-num-seqs: 128`, so the steady-state batch is the 128 in-flight requests.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: `configs/data/specbench-turn1.jsonl`, the 480 first turns of SpecBench (https://github.com/hemingkx/Spec-Bench) -- 80 each of translation, summarization, QA, maths reasoning and RAG, plus the 80 MT-bench categories at 10 each -- in a fixed row order (seed-0 permutation) and cycled to make the request bound. Prompt length is the data's: wire tokens mean 274.3, min 19, p50 66, p90 736, max 1431 (Llama-3.1 tokenizer, chat template, add_generation_prompt=True). Output is fixed at 256 tokens for every request (guidellm sets max_tokens=256 and ignore_eos=True), greedy at temperature 0.0.
purpose: A general-purpose 8B chat assistant handling varied single-turn tasks, 128 concurrent users, fixed 256-token replies, one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line: commit 95863540538804a48e31ca5806cefbac9d4c5326 (v0.14.0rc0-60-g9586354053).
# Interpreter and hardware seal: configs/env.yaml (not portable, per-machine).

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

# The EAGLE3 draft head trained against this exact target. Keep this on ONE line: the reader is
# line-by-line and skips indented lines, so a block mapping here drops the key silently.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 10}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# 2048 is the DRAFT head's own max_position_embeddings, and the engine clamps the drafter to
# min(draft, target); the longest request in the file is 1431 + 256 = 1687, so nothing truncates.
max-model-len: 2048

max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
enable-chunked-prefill: true

# NOT the engine default (it turns this on). The 480-row file is cycled, so with caching on the
# later passes would prefill out of cache and the run would stop describing the workload.
enable-prefix-caching: false

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
attention-backend: FLASH_ATTN
